USAGE: fscript [--help] [--root <path>] [--no-default-externs]
               [--extern-assembly <path>] [<path>]

SCRIPT:

    <path>                Path to the FScript source file (.fss).

OPTIONS:

    --root, -r <path>     Override sandbox root directory for filesystem
                          externs.
    --no-default-externs  Disable default runtime externs from
                          FScript.Runtime.Registry.
    --extern-assembly <path>
                          Load external-function providers from an assembly
                          path (repeatable).
    --help                display this list of options.
